mapper.select: with latest_voucher as ( select memnum, voucherid, startdate, enddate from ( select v.*, row_number() over (partition by v.memnum order by v.enddate desc, v.voucherid desc) rn from voucher_log v ) t where rn = 1 ), last_trainer as ( select memnum, empnum from ( select memnum, empnum, row_number() over (partition by memnum order by createdat desc, usageid desc) as rn from pt_log ) t where rn = 1 ), pt_balance as ( select memnum, ifnull(sum(countchange),0) as ptremain from pt_log group by memnum ) select m.memnum, m.memname, m.memgender, m.membirthday, m.memphone, m.mememail, m.memaddr, m.memcreated, m.memupdated, m.memprofile, m.memnote, e.empname as trainername, lv.startdate as voucherstartdate, lv.enddate as voucherenddate, pb.ptremain as ptremain, case when lv.enddate is null then '미사용중' when lv.enddate < curdate() then '미사용중' else '사용중' END AS membershipstatus, case when lv.enddate is null then 1 when lv.enddate < curdate() then 1 else 0 end as statussort -- 1=미사용중 먼저. 사용중 먼저로 바꾸려면 0/1을 뒤집거나 ORDER BY를 ASC로 변경 from member m left join last_trainer lt on lt.memnum = m.memnum left join employee e on e.empnum = lt.empnum left join latest_voucher lv on lv.memnum = m.memnum left join pt_balance pb on pb.memnum = m.memnum where ( #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} is null or upper(#{status}) = 'ALL' or (upper(#{status}) = 'USING' and lv.enddate is not null and lv.enddate >= curdate() ) or (upper(#{status}) = 'NOT_USING' and (lv.enddate is null or lv.enddate < curdate()) ) ) order by statussort desc, m.memcreated desc

with latest_voucher as ( select memnum, voucherid, startdate, enddate from ( select v.*, row_number() over (partition by v.memnum order by v.enddate desc, v.voucherid desc) rn from voucher_log v ) t where rn = 1 ), last_trainer as ( select memnum, empnum from ( select memnum, empnum, row_number() over (partition by memnum order by createdat desc, usageid desc) as rn from pt_log ) t where rn = 1 ), pt_balance as ( select memnum, ifnull(sum(countchange),0) as ptremain from pt_log group by memnum ) select m.memnum, m.memname, m.memgender, m.membirthday, m.memphone, m.mememail, m.memaddr, m.memcreated, m.memupdated, m.memprofile, m.memnote, e.empname as trainername, lv.startdate as voucherstartdate, lv.enddate as voucherenddate, pb.ptremain as ptremain, case when lv.enddate is null then '미사용중' when lv.enddate < curdate() then '미사용중' else '사용중' end as membershipstatus from member m left join last_trainer lt on lt.memnum = m.memnum left join employee e on e.empnum = lt.empnum left join latest_voucher lv on lv.memnum = m.memnum left join pt_balance pb on pb.memnum = m.memnum where m.memnum = #{memNum}
